tasks.name: Generation Design
tasks.objective: Produce the Generation Design for this project, meeting every acceptance criterion, then submit it for Studio Director review.
acceptance: Every generated layer listed with its algorithm and seed strategy
Guaranteed-content rules stated (what must always exist)
Determinism requirement stated: same seed, same world
Generation budget in milliseconds per chunk stated

tasks.name: Generator Implementation
tasks.objective: Produce the Generator Implementation for this project, meeting every acceptance criterion, then submit it for Studio Director review.
acceptance: Same seed reproduces the same world exactly
Generated content always satisfies the guaranteed-content rules
Chunk generation measured within its time budget

tasks.name: Generation Soak Test
tasks.objective: Produce the Generation Soak Test for this project, meeting every acceptance criterion, then submit it for Studio Director review.
acceptance: At least 100 seeds generated with no unreachable or invalid content
Worst-case generation time measured and within budget
Failure modes documented with reproduction seeds
